name: Dense Map Posterior (DMP)
description: It is not easy when evaluating 3D mapping performance because existing metrics require ground truth data that can only be collected with special instruments. In this paper, we propose a metric, dense map posterior (DMP), for this evaluation. It can work without any ground truth data. Instead, it calculates a comparable value, reflecting a map posterior probability, from dense point cloud observations. In our experiments, the proposed DMP is benchmarked against ground truth-based metrics. Results show that DMP can provide a similar evaluation capability. The proposed metric makes evaluating different methods more flexible and opens many new possibilities, such as self-supervised methods and more available datasets.
reputation: A specialized robotics evaluation metric proposed in a paper, with limited evidence of broad community adoption.
notes: This is a metric rather than a task benchmark; it is designed to avoid ground-truth dependence and is validated against ground-truth-based metrics in the paper.
